**President of METÁFORA: Arte, performance y creación en español** <br> [Rutgers University (2023-2024)]{style="font-size: 15px; color: #adb5bd; "} <br>

<li>Organized 8 creative workshops and interdisciplinary events celebrating Hispanic, Portuguese, and Luso-Brazilian arts and cultures.</li>
<li>Collaborated with faculty, guest speakers, and fellow students to provide hands-on workshops and meaningful cultural experiences.</li>
<li>Managed the SpanPort Department Grant for Developing Cultural Projects (2022-2024), overseeing a budget of $500 to support materials and food expenses for workshops and events.
<li>Coordinated logistics for all events, including room bookings, material preparation, food arrangements, and outreach to ensure smooth execution and engaging experiences.</li>
<li>Promoted events through marketing efforts, including flyer design, in order to enhance visibility within the Rutgers community.</li>
<br>

**Secretary of METÁFORA: Arte, performance y creación en español** <br> [Rutgers University (2022-2023)]{style="font-size: 15px; color: #adb5bd; "} <br>

<li>Co-organized and co-led 3 workshops as part of the Spanish Department's cultural initiatives.</li>
<li>Conceived a creative writing contest to celebrate the World Book Day and [Sant Jordi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Day_of_Books_and_Roses), and served as a judge for the contest.</li>
<li>Supported the president (Francisco Cantero Soriano) in event planning and logistics, contributing to the smooth execution of the department’s activities.</li>

<br>

**Spanish Instructor** <br> [Servei Solidari, Spain (2019-2020)]{style="font-size: 15px; color: #adb5bd; "} <br>

<li>Taught Spanish to immigrants and refugees at A1.1 to A2.2 levels (CEFR), preparing students for the Diploma de Español como Lengua Extranjera (A2 citizenship exam).</li>
<li>Developed and adapted course materials based on students' needs, interests, and the foundation's objectives.</li>
<li>Fostered a multicultural and multilingual learning environment to enhance student engagement and success.</li>
<li>Applied Cooperative Learning Strategies (e.g., Kagan, Slavin) and studied their impact on this demographic.</li>
<li>Delivered online training to volunteer teachers on Cooperative Learning methods and their application in language classrooms, focusing on strategies for Spanish as a Foreign and a Second Language.</li>
<li>Presented practical applications based on my research in Cooperative Learning and classroom experiences from my master's thesis and language teaching background.</li>

<br>

**Representative at Saló de l'Ensenyament** <br> [Universitat de Barcelona, Spain (2018)]{style="font-size: 15px; color: #adb5bd; "} <br>

<li>Represented the Languages and Literatures Departments from the University of Barcelona at Barcelona’s largest university student fair.</li>
<li>Provided detailed information about bachelor’s programs, answered questions from prospective students, and offered guidance on academic paths.</li>
<li>Engaged with a diverse audience to promote the university’s offerings and support student decision-making.</li>
